name: emtehani.vercel.app/emtehani-mcp
title: Emtehani Public MCP Server
description: Read-only public MCP server for Emtehani. Exposes platform information, the education stage/grade catalog, live service health, and public discovery links. It never exposes student, teacher, exam, answer, or result data.

tools.name: get_platform_info
tools.title: Get platform information
tools.description: Return public information about Emtehani: what the platform does, who it serves, and canonical public URLs.

tools.name: list_education_catalog
tools.title: List education stages and grades
tools.description: Return the supported education stages and the grades belonging to each stage. This is static public catalog data, not student data.

tools.name: get_service_health
tools.title: Get service health
tools.description: Run the Emtehani health checks, including database connectivity, and return the current status.

tools.name: get_discovery_links
tools.title: Get discovery links
tools.description: Return canonical links to the API catalog, OpenAPI specification, API documentation, authentication guide, AI catalog, and Agent Skills index.
